edits.text: PARTIES; EFFECTIVE DATE. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the Company) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the Executive), effective [effective date].

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $350,000 (Base Salary), payable through the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to required withholding. The Executive shall be eligible for the full employee and executive benefits made available to similarly situated executives, subject to applicable plan terms.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall pay 18 months of Base Salary at the rate in effect immediately before termination, disregarding any reduction giving rise to Good Reason, in regular payroll installments beginning on the first regular payroll date following termination. The Company shall also continue the Executive’s benefits on the same economic basis for 18 months following termination. If continuation is unavailable under applicable law or plan terms, the Company shall provide an economically equivalent substitute to the extent lawful. Accrued salary, reimbursable expenses, and vested benefits shall be paid separately in accordance with applicable law and plan terms. Cause means only (a) conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty materially related to the Executive’s duties; (b) willful fraud, embezzlement, or material dishonesty against the Company; or (c) a willful and material breach of this Agreement or willful misconduct in performing duties that causes material harm to the Company. No act or omission undertaken in good faith with a reasonable belief that it served the Company’s interests constitutes willful conduct. A Cause termination requires written notice describing the grounds in reasonable detail, at least 30 days to cure any curable matter, and an opportunity to be heard by the Board before its good-faith determination. Good Reason means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in Base Salary, a material diminution in authority, duties, or responsibilities, relocation of the principal work location by more than 50 miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. The Executive must give written notice within 90 days after learning of the condition, allow the Company 30 days to cure, and resign within 60 days after the cure period expires if the condition remains uncured.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY; TRADE SECRETS; NO NON-COMPETE. No post-employment non-competition restriction applies. The Executive shall not use or disclose the Company’s nonpublic proprietary business information except in performing duties for the Company or as authorized or permitted by law. This obligation excludes information that becomes public without breach, is lawfully obtained from a third party without a confidentiality duty, or is independently developed without use of protected information. Protection lasts only while the information remains confidential; trade secrets are protected while they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law. Nothing restricts lawful competition, use of general skills and experience, protected discussion of employment terms, reporting suspected violations to government authorities, cooperating in investigations, or other legally protected activity. No prior Company authorization or notice is required for protected reporting. Under 18 U.S.C. § 1833(b), an individual is immune from federal and state trade-secret liability for a disclosure made in confidence to a government official or attorney solely to report or investigate a suspected legal violation, or in a complaint or other filing made under seal. An individual bringing a retaliation action for reporting a suspected violation may disclose trade secrets to counsel and use them in that action if filings containing them are under seal and disclosure occurs only pursuant to court order. 5. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of [jurisdiction to be agreed], subject to applicable mandatory law.
